input.input: Which tests or pipelines across this org are flaky — failing then passing on retry? Give names and counts. Include the exact HQL queries you ran to arrive at the answer. After you finish, explicitly list which skills (if any) you loaded/used to arrive at this answer.

expected_output.output: A correct answer names the real pipeline(s)/step(s) exhibiting a genuine fail-then-pass-on-retry pattern, with real counts retrieved from the Knowledge Graph, and explicitly distinguishes flaky (intermittent) behavior from consistently-failing steps — not a fabricated test/step name or count. The agent must correctly resolve org-level scope rather than defaulting to a single project_identifier filter, which would incorrectly return zero rows in this environment. If no flaky pattern is found, the agent must say so. The HQL should use valid KG entities (pipeline:pipeline, pipeline:pipeline_execution, pipeline:stage_execution, pipeline:step_execution, ci:test_execution) and declared join keys (pipeline->pipeline_execution on identifier=pipeline_identifier; pipeline_execution->stage_execution on plan_execution_id; stage_execution->step_execution on stage_execution_id, filtering is_retried=true), deriving flakiness primarily from a FAIL-then-PASS sequence rather than guessed. As a secondary, soft expectation, the agent should ideally self-report having loaded/used the Knowledge Graph / kg_analysis skill (and the HQL it ran) when asked which skills it used.

input.input: Which pipelines are being retried because of failing tests in the last 30 days? Include the exact HQL queries you ran to arrive at the answer. After you finish, explicitly list which skills (if any) you loaded/used to arrive at this answer.

expected_output.output: A correct answer identifies the real pipeline(s) showing a retry pattern within the last 30 days — step failures exceeding pipeline failures, indicating fail-then-retry-until-pass — grounded in retrieved step-execution data, not invented pipelines. If none are found within the window, the agent must say so rather than fabricating one. The HQL should honor the 30-day window and project scope, using pipeline:pipeline_execution -> pipeline:stage_execution (plan_execution_id) -> pipeline:step_execution (stage_execution_id, is_retried=true). As a secondary, soft expectation, the agent should ideally self-report having loaded/used the Knowledge Graph / kg_analysis skill (and the HQL it ran) when asked which skills it used.
